fns.desc: In ieee802_1x_create_preshared_mka_hapd(), cak->key is populated via os_memcpy from hapd->conf->mka_cak (the actual pre-shared CAK secret, line 479) but freed with plain os_free(cak) at the free_cak label instead of bin_clear_free() — leaves live key material in freed/reused heap memory. Contrast with ieee802_1x_notify_create_actor_hapd() in the same file, which correctly uses bin_clear_free() for the equivalent msk/cak buffers.

In l2_packet_init(), l2_ndisuio_global->refcount is incremented at line 368 before the os_zalloc(sizeof(struct l2_packet_data)) at line 370; if that allocation fails, the function returns NULL at line 372 without decrementing refcount (or freeing/resetting a freshly-allocated l2_ndisuio_global on the first-call path), leaving the global's connection-accounting permanently inconsistent for subsequent init/deinit calls.
